explanation.headline: Doxycycline hyclate is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; three hospital sites hold 18.7 to 30.1 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include doxycycline hyclate as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 479 capsules of the 100 mg presentation at 16.1 per day for 29.8 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 449 capsules at 14.9 per day for 30.1 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 50 capsules at 2.7 per day for 18.7 days on hand.
The rule-identified best option is to buy from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.
Two manufacturers, Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., have posted discontinuations for doxycycline hyclate tablets on 2026-01-12 and 2026-07-30 respectively.
A label for a Viona Pharmaceuticals Inc. product identifies Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3007938603) as a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2023-03-24.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
